capabilities: Compute column statistics from a formula placed in a table cell
Insert tables and statistic rows from the right-click menu
Run statistic commands from the command palette
Fill a column with row-wise formulas such as rowmean and rowsum
Read numbers that contain commas, dollar signs and percent signs
extras: Install instructions require copying the plugin folder into the vault's .obsidian/plugins directory by hand; formula text stays in the note and results appear only in Reading view.
problem: Markdown tables cannot total or summarize their numbers, so users count and average values by hand or move the data into a spreadsheet.
summary: Adds formulas to Markdown table cells that compute sum, mean, median, min, max, count and other statistics over the numbers in a column or row.
